admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Manage lab members, budgets and models, and keep an eye on the system.

link.description: {email} sets a password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours.
link.notEmailed: The email could not be sent. Share the link below yourself, through a private channel.
link.label: Set-password link
link.warning: Until it is used, anyone with this link can take over the account. Do not post it publicly.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Creates the account and sends a single-use link to set the password.
invite.name: Name

paidModels.title: Paid models
paidModels.description: Kill switch for the whole lab. When off, every run uses free models, whatever the budgets.
paidModels.off: Paid models off: free models only
paidModels.disabledToast: Paid models are off. Runs now use free models only.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone with an account in the lab. Suspended accounts cannot sign in.

offboarding.suspendDescription: {email} will no longer be able to sign in, and every open session ends within a minute. Their projects, runs and budget stay as they are, and you can restore access at any time.
offboarding.restoreDescription: {email} can sign in again with their password. If they no longer know it, send them a new password link.
offboarding.signOutDescription: Every open session of {email} ends within a minute. Their password keeps working, so they can sign in again.
offboarding.suspended: {name} is suspended and signed out everywhere.

errors.OWN_ACCOUNT: You cannot do this to your own account. Ask another lab admin.
errors.YOU_CANNOT_BAN_YOURSELF: You cannot suspend your own account. Ask another lab admin.
errors.YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_BAN_USERS: Only lab admins can suspend or restore accounts.
errors.YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_REVOKE_USERS_SESS: Only lab admins can sign people out.

budgets.title: Monthly budgets
budgets.description: Paid-model budgets in USD. They reset on the 1st of each month (UTC); without one, a person's runs use free models.

routing.title: Model routing
routing.description: The models each agent role tries, in order. Paid models are used while the person's budget allows; then the free models take over.
routing.paidOffNotice: Paid models are switched off for the whole lab, so every role uses its free models.
routing.maxOutput: Up to {tokens} output tokens per call
routing.skipped: Skipped while paid models are off
routing.notInCatalog: Not in the model catalog: price and context unknown

balance.title: Lab balance
balance.description: The lab's prepaid OpenRouter credit, this month's paid spend and today's free-model use.
balance.belowFloor: It is below {floor}. Top up the lab's OpenRouter credit before paid calls start to fail.
balance.freeHint: The daily limit is shared by the whole lab and resets at midnight (UTC).

health.title: System health
health.description: Every service is checked every 15 seconds while this page is open.
health.checked: Checked {time}. Every service is checked every 15 seconds while this page is open.

health.slow: It answered, but took longer than a second.
health.no_pollers: No worker is listening for tasks, so runs cannot make progress.
health.partial_pollers: Only some workers are listening: workflows or activities have no worker.
health.unconfigured: The API is not configured to check it.
health.unsupported: The workflow engine cannot report its workers.

db.unavailable: The API has no database connection.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Changes people made through the API, newest first.

project.member_set: Added a member or changed their role

settings.paid_models: Switched paid models on or off
